aggressive.title: Aggressive Mode
aggressive.text: Highly recommended for a massive performance boost! turn it off if the game you are playing detects thermal modification.

aggressiveHal.title: Disable Thermal HAL
aggressiveHal.text: Masks vendor thermal HAL libraries while Aggressive Mode is active. Turn it off if the game or the system thermal service misbehaves (crash, freeze, or stuck temperature readings).

fastCharge.title: Fast Charge
fastCharge.text: Turns off some temperature sensors to force maximum charging speed.

modeOptions.title: Operation Mode
modeOptions.text:
Auto: Thermal limits are only disabled for the apps you pick in the Apps tab.
Static: Permanently disabled all the time.

zonePolicy.title: Thermal Policy
zonePolicy.text: Sets how the kernel reacts when temps hit a certain limit. Just leave it on default if you're not sure.

kernelPanic.title: Disable Kernel Panic
kernelPanic.text: Prevents random reboots by ignoring minor system crashes. Useful for fixing stability issues.

thermalZone.title: Thermal Zone
thermalZone.text:
Kill Thermal Zone: Kill all thermal zones.
Spoof to 30°C: Spoof thermal zone temperature to 30°C.
